The Philistine said to David, “Am I a dog, that you come to me with sticks?” The Philistine cursed David by his gods.
Then Abner was very angry about Ishbosheth’s words, and said, “Am I a dog’s head that belongs to Judah? Today I show…
He bowed down, and said, “What is your servant, that you should look at such a dead dog as I am?”
Then Abishai the son of Zeruiah said to the king, “Why should this dead dog curse my lord the king? Please let me go…
Now therefore, don’t let my blood fall to the earth away from the presence of Yahweh; for the king of Israel has come…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Against whom has the king of Israel come out? Whom do you pursue? A dead dog? A flea?
translations.bsb: Against whom has the king of Israel come out? Whom are you pursuing? A dead dog? A flea?
